presets.description: Four to one over a six-decibel knee at minus eighteen: a general-purpose starting point.
presets.name: Default

presets.description: Two to one over a wide knee, a slow attack and the release left to the programme: holds a piano together without touching its transients.
presets.name: Piano Glue

presets.description: Eight to one, a millisecond of attack, a peak detector with the low end filtered out of it: catches what sticks out.
presets.name: Peak Tamer

presets.description: Ten to one from minus thirty, made up automatically and blended at forty percent: density under the dry signal.
presets.name: Parallel Crush

presets.description: Three to one over a nine-decibel knee, the release following the programme: level without a hand on the fader.
presets.name: Vocal-ish Smooth

presets.description: Four to one with a twenty-millisecond attack and six decibels of range: adds movement while keeping the first hit intact.
presets.name: Drum Bus

presets.description: Two to one over a broad knee with automatic release and eight decibels of range: restrained long-term levelling.
presets.name: Level Rider
